title: Record envelope
description: Every stored record. Code owns every field here. Only 'content' holds LLM-drafted data, and it is validated separately against the content schema of the record's register. Never sent to an LLM provider.

register.description: Register name, for example decision-log or risk-register.

schema_version.description: Version (MAJOR.MINOR) of the content schema the content was validated against.

record_status.description: Record lifecycle, set by code. Domain states (for example a risk being open or closed) live in content.

content.description: Register-specific content drafted by a Registrar (specialist record keeper).

record_id.description: Register prefix and sequence number, for example DEC-0001. Assigned by code.

artifact_id.description: Artifact Ledger ID, for example ART-0001. Assigned by code.

source.description: One verified quote from one artifact. A record has one source entry per verified quote.

artifact_date.description: Artifact date copied from the Artifact Ledger, when known.

excerpt.description: The quote as drafted, after it passed the evidence check.

relations.description: Links between records. Proposed by the Comparator (reconciliation), checked and written by code.

history_entry.description: One change to the record. Append-only.

change.description: 'supersession' is written on the new record; 'superseded' on the record it replaces.

fields.description: Content fields set or changed in this revision.

related_id.description: The other record in a supersession.

model.description: Model that drafted this revision, if an LLM was involved.

prompt_version.description: Version of the Registrar prompt used, if an LLM was involved.
